name: fernery-webapp
description: Fernery: complete Full-stack app command-line tool example app. Self-hostable, Apache-2.0, built on cenius.ai.

paragraphs: Fernery gives you two paths: self-host the Apache-2.0-licensed Full-stack app source as your own command-line tool, or open it on cenius.ai, describe the changes you want, and receive a new Fernery build with full rebrand rights. Fernery is a single-file, stdlib-only Python CLI for local fern care records: frond unfurling stages, spore print listings, and rhizome division logs. Everything ships in this repo — no paywall, no hidden features, no separate Fernery download.

▶ Open & edit in cenius.ai — one click to an editable workspace: describe changes in plain English, get an instant preview, one-click deploy and host. Modifications made on the platform come with full rebrand & relicense rights.
Local clone? See Quick start below. cenius.ai is the zero-setup path.
